market_context.headline: US markets mixed; AI/semiconductor weakness after Broadcom weighs on tech while Health Care rotates higher.
market_context.summary: Tech/AI was under pressure, especially semiconductors, while defensive Health Care acted as stabilizer. Small caps and Bitcoin were weaker, signaling caution ahead of the US jobs report and CPI/FOMC catalyst chain.

top_news.title: Broadcom disappoints AI expectations
top_news.impact: negative for semiconductors, AI infrastructure, Nasdaq/QQQ
top_news.interpretation: Not necessarily an end to the AI trend, but a warning that high valuation stocks need exceptional guidance, not merely solid execution.

top_news.title: US jobs report due Friday, 5 June 2026 at 08:30 ET
top_news.impact: binary macro catalyst for Fed path, yields, USD, and growth multiples
top_news.interpretation: Strong jobs may support growth but pressure rate-cut hopes; weak jobs may help Fed-dove expectations but could trigger recession concerns if too weak.

top_news.title: Geopolitics and oil remain latent inflation risk
top_news.impact: mixed; lower oil supports inflation relief, escalation would hurt margins and sentiment
top_news.interpretation: Oil and Middle East headlines remain a macro overlay that can quickly change inflation and Fed expectations.

ETFs.SPY: Hold/selective accumulation if jobs report does not become hawkish shock.
ETFs.QQQ_XLK: Stage entries only; avoid aggressive buying before NFP and CPI.
ETFs.IWM: Wait for clearer rates and labor market signal.

portfolio_themes.Health_AI: Health Care remains attractive as stabilizer; Health+AI is still interesting where there is real efficiency and earnings relevance.
portfolio_themes.Tech: Long-term strong but short-term overheated; Broadcom weakness suggests AI exposure should be quality-filtered.
portfolio_themes.Crypto: Bitcoin under pressure; treat as high-beta risk asset, not safe haven, until risk appetite stabilizes.

US_Tech_Momentum.interpretation: Broadcom weighs on AI/semis; QQQ and XLK weak but no crash.

Health_Rotation.interpretation: XLV positive and Health Care acting as defensive winner.

Risk_Sentiment.interpretation: No broad panic, but small caps and crypto weak ahead of jobs report.

Volatility.interpretation: Nervousness increased but move looks more rotational than full risk-off.

Overall_Market.interpretation: Neutral with negative tech bias; market breadth not broken but AI valuations are being tested.

trigger_calendar.event: US Employment Situation / Nonfarm Payrolls May
trigger_calendar.why_it_matters: Directly affects Fed path, yields, growth multiples and USD.
trigger_calendar.hotter_stronger_effect: Yields higher, Fed less dovish, pressure on QQQ/tech.
trigger_calendar.cooler_weaker_effect: Supports rate-cut hopes and duration tech, unless too weak and recessionary.

trigger_calendar.why_it_matters: Tests demand at short/mid part of curve before CPI/Fed.
trigger_calendar.hotter_stronger_effect: Weak demand means yields higher and pressure on growth.
Fed-hawkish repricing, USD/yields higher, tech negative.

trigger_calendar.why_it_matters: Duration demand directly impacts tech valuations.
Long-end rates affect equity risk premium, mortgages and credit sentiment.
trigger_calendar.hotter_stronger_effect: Weak auction lifts long-end yields and pressures risk assets.

trigger_calendar.why_it_matters: Fed decision and summer policy signal.
trigger_calendar.hotter_stronger_effect: Hawkish message pressures valuations and strengthens USD.
trigger_calendar.cooler_weaker_effect: Dovish message supports rally potential, especially tech and small caps.

hypothetical_recommendation.action: Do not aggressively buy the dip in AI/semis before NFP and CPI; keep cash reserve, hold quality tech, maintain/consider slight Health Care overweight.
hypothetical_recommendation.risk_note: Existing tech overweight should be reviewed but not panic-sold.

confidence.reason: Market move is explainable by Broadcom/AI disappointment, jobs-event risk and Health Care rotation; uncertainty remains high because NFP and CPI can overwrite the setup.
